podcast.title: 2000 Chart Presence
podcast.body: The Presidents of the United States of America were noted as a band on the charts in 2000, used as an example of rock acts that, in the eyes of many fans, offered a limited number of quality songs across their albums, signaling a difficult period for the genre. "If you look at the charts for 2000, we have bands like Mest, Eve 6, Fuel, Oliander, Lifhouse, Primitive Radio Gods, the Presidents of the United States of America."
